recipe-pages/french-macarons.html: French macarons are delicate, meringue-based sandwich cookies known for their smooth tops, ruffled "foot," and rich filling.
recipe-pages/gevulde-koek.html: Gevulde Koek is a beloved Dutch classic — a round shortcrust cookie filled with sweet almond paste and topped with a single almond.
recipe-pages/vanillekipferl.html: A beloved staple of Austrian and German Christmas baking, Vanillekipferl are delicate, crescent-shaped shortbread cookies rolled in vanilla sugar.
